name: Saoirse O'Malley
bio:
Saoirse O'Malley's journey into motorsport began in her father's Dublin garage, where she spent her youth dismantling and rebuilding engines. This hands-on experience ignited a lifelong passion for mechanical precision. Saoirse pursued a degree in mechanical engineering before specializing in motorsport machining. She worked for several prominent racing teams, honing her skills in fabricating and maintaining high-performance components. 

Saoirse's approach to her role is meticulous and pragmatic. She believes in continuous improvement and embraces innovative solutions to optimize performance and reliability. Her management experience comes from leading small teams in previous roles, where she fostered a collaborative environment. What sets Saoirse apart is her ability to quickly diagnose complex mechanical issues and implement effective solutions under pressure. She's known for her calm demeanor, even in the most stressful race situations.

Now a free agent, Saoirse is eager to bring her extensive experience and unwavering commitment to a new challenge. She thrives in fast-paced environments and is always seeking opportunities to push the boundaries of mechanical engineering in motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Saoirse is of average height with a strong, capable build, and a smattering of freckles across her nose.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn wrench that was her father's.
Insists on listening to traditional Irish music while calibrating sensitive equipment.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning her tools after every use, no matter how rushed the situation.
